deck: L0 turbofan_point, not an L1 thermodynamic deck
deck_note: The jet path has no L1 cycle deck. The comparison is the L0 high-bypass correlation (Mattingly, Heiser and Pratt 2002, Ch. 2; Ihme 2025 Eq. 2.77). It was not relabelled L1.
local_numpy_patch: ThermoAdd reactant mode squeezed a shape-(1,) mix flow to a 0-d value and kept the dtype. float() was not used. The patch is not in the repository. Unmodified 4.4.0 on NumPy 2.5.5 stops in ThermoAdd before the solver.
sqrt_warning: static_ps_resid printed invalid value encountered in sqrt. Net thrust still met each target within 0.002 lbf. That match is not a printed Newton residual.

l0.od1_thrust_note: The pyCycle off-design thrust is the commanded target, 8000 lbf. The L0 number is a maximum-rating prediction. The two are not the same quantity, so no thrust ratio is formed.

note: The example is a turbojet (pressure ratio 13.5, turbine inlet 2370 R). The L0 correlation is a high-bypass turbofan. A TSFC ratio near 2 is a difference of engine class, not a factor for the deck. SLS thrust was aligned by choosing the L0 sea-level thrust; that alignment is by construction. The L0 function was not edited.
